title: Gazebo Blank Message
text: Create blank Gazebo command, 1 output, {Message type} sets Type of message; {Sample time} sets the sampling time of input. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Message type
params.values: Type of message ApplyLinkWrench (default) | ApplyJointTorque | SetLinkWorldPose | SetLinkLinearVelocity | SetLinkAngularVelocity | SetJointPosition | SetJointVelocity
